data.content: U.S. Men's National Soccer Team. # USMNT projected lineup vs Chile: Will Pochettino rotate his side? The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.title: Canada beat Chile to open 2030 FIFA World Cup cycle - Yahoo Sports
data.content: * Presidents Cup: U.S. chips away. # Canada beat Chile to open 2030 FIFA World Cup cycle. Canada opened their 2030 FIFA World Cup cycle with a 1-0 victory against nine-man Chile at Toronto FC's BMO Field on Saturday night. In-form Jonathan David scored the lone goal for Les Rouges in the 12th minute, tapping in a rebound after Chile goalkeeper Lawrence Vigouroux stunningly denied Cyle Larin from point-blank range. Chile were reduced to 10 men in the 36th minute when Lucas Cepeda was shown a straight red card for a high boot that bloodied Richie Laryea. Canada now turn their attention toward another South American foe, with a match against Peru from CF Montréal's Stade Saputo coming up next Saturday. * 12' - CAN - Jonathan David | WATCH. * CAN: Saturday, October 3 vs. Peru | 2 pm ET | International friendly.
